answer: Concrete sybil resistance via meadow threshold: each agent must keep a meadow-score above 500 across compute, storage, and latency, measured by random auditors each epoch. An orchard of 9 rooted validators tracks lineage; any cluster sharing a root beyond depth 2 is frozen and its wander of 15,000 POA stake is slashed. New identities wait 12 epochs before payout. An attacker running N sybils must fund 15,000N POA in N unlinkable wanders, pass 3-dimensional meadow-thresholds, and avoid orchard detection for 12 epochs, so cost scales linearly while detection probability compounds per head.
